title: A species or form: res/pokemon/<species>/data.json or form_<n>.json
description: One record of the species data (archive a/0/1/6, the 0x4c bytes that PML_PersonalGetParam reads), with the record's level-up moves (a/0/1/8), evolutions (a/0/1/9) and, for a species, baby species (a/0/2/0). tools/data/species_data.py packs them. A string value is the name of a constant from generated/ or include/constants/.

name.description: The species' name, which the text files take with \from{species.name}, also in capitals and with its article. National Pokédex species only: forms, the egg, the bad egg and the Pokéstar Studios species have none, whose names are lines of species_names.txt

name_article.description: The article of the name where it isn't "an" before a vowel and "a" before anything else, as for Uxie

pokedex.description: The species' Pokédex text and search shape (species only), or false for an added species that never enters the Pokédex: no Pokédex bits, list row or Wonder Trade entry, as the Pokéstar Studios species (docs/paperwhite2/design/new-species.md, tools/data/species_list.py)

types.description: The two types, the same twice for a single type

evolution_stage.description: 1 for a species that doesn't evolve from another, then 2 and 3 along its evolutions

ev_yields.description: The effort values that a defeated Pokémon of the species gives, 0 to 3 each

underground.description: Set only for Diglett and Dugtrio, which live in the ground; the battle animations' script commands test it (overlay 168)

held_items.description: The items wild Pokémon of the species hold, from the most to the least common

gender_ratio.description: The chance of a female out of 254, or a GENDER_RATIO_* constant

egg_groups.description: The two egg groups (EGG_GROUP_*), the same twice for one

abilities.description: The two abilities, the second ABILITY_NONE for one

hidden_ability.description: The ability from the Dream World

cry_volume.description: Playback volume from a/1/9/1 for species with a cry; absent for forms and extra personal records

forms.description: The species' forms. Their records follow the order of res/pokemon/forms.json, which the packer sets the record of the first form from; forms that only change the sprite have no record

count.description: The number of forms, 1 for a species without forms

sprite_offset.description: Where the forms' sprites start among the alternate forms' sprites: form n's sprite group is sprite_offset + n - 1, its art res/pokemon/<species>/form_<n>/. Groups 0 to 65 are the original game's; from 66 they are Paper White 2's, which the battle sprites' archive appends after the Substitute's files and Arceus' palettes, and which must follow 65 without gaps (tools/data/pokemon_graphics.py). A species with more forms than its original groups keeps its original offset here, and the packers move all its forms after the hack's groups, giving its record the moved offset (tools/data/form_groups.py). 0 for none, and for forms told apart only by their palette (palette_forms) an index of the palettes instead

no_evolution.description: Paper White 2: the forms that never evolve, whatever the species' evolutions say, such as the Spiky-eared Pichu's 1 (CheckEvolveSpecies, and the Pokédex Info page's Evo shows them alone). The hack's build only (tools/paperwhite2/pokemon_forms.py)

pokedex.description: Paper White 2: false keeps the forms out of the Pokédex's form lists, which then record and show form 0 only, as the original does for Arceus and Genesect. Absent means true: a species with more than one form gets a row of the Pokédex's form directory (POKEDEX_FORM_LIST, the save's form bits). The hack's build only (tools/paperwhite2/pokemon_forms.py, docs/paperwhite2/design/save-expansion.md)

color.description: The Pokédex color, a COLOR_* constant

asymmetric.description: Set for the species that don't look the same mirrored, such as Kingler, Zangoose and Absol

palette_forms.description: Set for a species whose forms only change its palette (Arceus): a form's sprite is a palette rather than files of its own (GetPokemonDataIDBase)

base_exp.description: The base of the experience that defeating a Pokémon of the species gives

by_level.description: The moves learned by level, as [ level, move ], in the order the game checks them

by_tm.description: The TMs (TM01 to TM95) and HMs (HM01 to HM06) the species can learn

egg_moves.description: The moves the species' eggs can hatch knowing (a/1/2/4). Species only, and not SPECIES_NONE, whose entry is empty

by_tutor.description: The moves the species learns from the type move tutor (the pledges, the starters' ultimate moves and Draco Meteor) and the move tutors of Driftveil City, Lentimas Town, Humilau City and Nacrene City, whose lists are their shop tables in src/ov036/scrcmd_shop.c

evolutions.description: Up to seven evolutions. A form's record (form_<n>.json) has none: the game reads a species' evolutions by species, for all its forms, and an entry's form says which form takes it

param.description: Depends on the method: a level, an item, a move, a species, or a value such as the friendship or beauty needed

form.description: Paper White 2: only a Pokémon of this form evolves this way (such as an Alolan Vulpix, form 1, by an Ice Rock); without it, every form does. The evolved Pokémon keeps its form number. Packed in the method's high byte as form + 1 (PaperWhite2_FilterFormEvolutions in CheckEvolveSpecies)

regional_dex_number.description: The number in the Unova Pokédex, from 0 for Victini, or null for a species not in it. The table after the species records (a/0/1/6's last member) holds one for each species, 999 for none: its 301 numbers match the game's Unova Pokédex, #000 to #300. Forms have none

baby_species.description: The species that hatches from an egg this one lays, its first evolution stage. Forms have none

pokedex_text.title: In the Pokédex
pokedex_text.description: The species' Pokédex text, which the text files take with \from{species.pokedex.<field>} and the like, and its search shape. Species only

entry.description: The entry, with its line breaks

height.description: The height as the Pokédex shows it; the record's height is the number the game uses

weight.description: The weight as the Pokédex shows it, rounded as the game's text has it; the record's weight is the number the game uses

form_name.description: The first form's name on the Pokédex's forms page and the Info page's tab (pokedex_detail_form.txt), such as "Plant Cloak", for a species with forms; empty when left out

forms.description: The alternate forms' names, entries, heights, weights and shapes, one for each form after the first (forms.count - 1), Unown's and Arceus' too. tools/data/pokedex_data.py links them to their species in this order, so a form added here keeps every other form's text

name.description: The form's name, as form_name, such as "Sandy Cloak"

languages.description: The Pokédex text the game keeps in other languages, which a Pokémon from a game in that language shows: for the species up to Arceus, and the Japanese category of every species. The heights and weights of Giratina's and Shaymin's alternate forms follow the species' in the files, as their forms

pokedex_shape.description: The body shape that the Pokédex's search finds it by, one of its 14 shape icons (a/0/9/7 file 2, PokedexSearchEngine_GetShape)
